MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

2. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.205

3. Solve for x: x + 4 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 7
   D. 11

4. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 31
   C. 41
   D. 49

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 42

7. Solve for x: x + 9 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 9
   C. 19
   D. 11

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

9. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 15
   C. 57
   D. 1

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 15
   D. 13

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

13. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 24
   C. 10
   D. 25

14. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 4

15. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 41
   D. 3

16. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 16

17. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 17

18. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

19. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 26

20. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 12

21. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

22. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

23. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 81

24. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

25. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 9
   D. 21

26. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

27. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 49

28. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 33

29. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

30. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal
